_meta.note: Curated SEED catalog for MEHFIL. This file is the human-curated taste + metadata + synesthetic-tag layer. The Phase 2 ingestion pipeline RESOLVES the empty/null fields by matching each seed track to an official-label upload on YouTube, then EXPANDS the catalog with additional discovered tracks from the source registry. Do NOT invent sourceId/video IDs — leave them "" until a real API run resolves them.
_meta.curatorHints: `provenance.label` is the expected rights-holder, used to pick which official channel to search first. `raga` is null unless confidently known — fill accurate ragas during curation; the synesthetic bloom also reads mood/tempoBucket/timeOfDay, which are always set.
